method.metric_10: Population variance (ddof=0) of single player-game lines by line and role. T is abs(ln(var_2024/var_2023)); zero-variance comparisons are not evaluable.
method.metric_11: Role-specific 2022 empirical p95/p99 cutoffs by line, using linear interpolation at rank (n-1)*p. Tail frequency is the share strictly greater than the fixed cutoff. T is abs(freq_2024-freq_2023).
method.metric_8: 2023 uses 2022 role-specific linear-interpolated empirical intervals; 2024 uses 2022-2023 pooled intervals. Coverage includes both endpoints. Envelopes are min/max of the two held-out fold coverages.
method.metric_9: League mean per active-roster player-game by line and role. T is the absolute 2024 minus 2023 mean difference.

population.roster: ACT weekly roster player-games, regular season weeks 1-18
population.zero_fill: All metric-7 player lines are zero-filled for ACT player-games without an observed line.

season_policy: Fixed explicit hashed 2022-2024 files only; source row seasons are checked; no other season is accepted.
